description: This PHP file defines a database migration class for version 4.6.0 of the OrangeHRM software. It creates and modifies database tables related to internationalization (i18n), such as language groups, languages, language strings, translations, and sources. It also inserts initial data and integrates with the admin menu system.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A database migration class for setting up internationalization tables and initial data for OrangeHRM version 4.6.0.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Performs the migration: creates tables if they do not exist, adds constraints, inserts initial data, and adds menu entries.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string of the migration, '4.6'.

methods.name: readlanguageYaml
methods.description: Reads a YAML file containing language data and returns it as an array.

methods.name: insertLanguages
methods.description: Inserts language data into the 'ohrm_i18n_language' table.

methods.name: insertGroups
methods.description: Inserts language group data into the 'ohrm_i18n_group' table.
